text: At N=128 with m2 fixed and 6000 steps, val_mse_ratio is 0.022 in both seeds 22-23, yet trained force R2 is only 0.68-0.70. If the N=64 runs of the same seeds are read at their checkpoint with val_mse_ratio about 0.022, at the same layer, is the N=64 minus N=128 trained force R2 gap still >= 0.05? In other words, is the N=128 force deficit present at matched loss as well as at matched step?
